# The Meadow badge swaps packaged artwork and localized image attributes together

The owned patch changes the About Dialog image to the packaged Meadow WebP resource and binds about-dialog-meadow-logo. The corresponding Fluent message supplies alternative and title text, and the jar mapping changes with the image URL. The patch does not change sizing CSS. Current branding sizes and later asset bytes are separate accepted phases. Static artwork inspection is not proof of the About Dialog layout or accessible name at runtime.

Scope: Thunderbird About Dialog Meadow resource wiring.
